What management practices can be implemented to control Tristeza or quick decline in citrus orchards?

Effective management of Tristeza or quick decline in citrus orchards involves implementing several practices. For sweet orange and mandarin, avoiding susceptible rootstocks is crucial. For acid lime, using seedlings preimmunized with the mild strain of tristeza can help prevent infection. Additionally, careful monitoring and management of aphid populations, along with sanitation practices to prevent the spread of infected budwood, are essential for controlling the disease in citrus orchards.
